name: Minnesota Business Venture (MBV)
what_you_do: Teams build a made-up product and business plan, then pitch it Shark Tank style at the end of the week. Includes speakers, mock interviews and breakouts.
who_can_apply: Any student in grades 9 to 12, from public, private, charter and home schools.
pay_detail: $400 by March 31, 2027; $500 after. This covers meals, housing and the program. Call 763-233-6325.
duration: June 27 to July 2, 2027 (Sunday noon to Friday noon). You live on campus.
deadline_text: MBV is June 27 to July 2, 2027. Applications open in early December 2026. Spots go first come, first served.
how_to_apply: Apply online when the form opens. You can also ask for a paper form at mbv@bestprep.org or 763-233-6325. Send the application fee with it.
notes: Held at the University of St Thomas in St. Paul. The FAQ prints 2026 for the June dates and says Minnesota students. The page says 2027 and any U.S. student, so ask. BestPrep also lists an Educational Forum on Feb 17, 2027. It is at the Minneapolis Convention Center.
